name: Translation + CLIR Drill
text:
1
Translation + CLIR Drill
1 SECTION
Instructions

Start a stopwatch.

Read and translate the stimulus* out loud in chunks.

Quip each chunk of the stimulus after you translate.

Continue this process on every stimulus chunk until you reach the end of stimulus.

Immediately proceed to the CLIR after your final quip of the stimulus (or the final quip is the CLIR).

Stop the stopwatch and record your time.

SEE FULL WORKOUT DETAILS

name: MemAC (Memory Answer Choice Translation)
text:
2
MemAC (Memory Answer Choice Translation)
Instructions

NOTE: MemAC is a multi-day series of workouts using previously-seen LR and RC sections that progress through five levels as you meet certain benchmarks. Each level and benchmark is defined below. MemAC can be completed as a full section* or by completing as much MemAC as possible in 1-3 hour blocks.

Start MemAC at Level 1, or from wherever you left off previously.

Level 1 MemAC means that you will be performing the answer choice Translation process defined in the Level 1 instructions below. If you are on a later Level, follow the corresponding instructions below.

To Level Up: Complete the full MemAC process defined in your Level instructions without having to peek at the answer choices to accurately remember them on 10 questions in a row.

For example, if you correctly recap all the answer choices on 10 questions in a row without having to peek on Level 1, move to Level 2 on the next question.

Each time you complete one full section of MemAC, complete a MemAC Live Check-In Question(defined below).

MemAC Live Check-In Question

Complete a full LR question according to the Full LR Process. 

Just translate and quip the answers normally. Do not do MemAC.

After choosing your answer, attempt to translate all the answer choices from memory. 

Write down how many answers you're able to translate from memory on each Live Check-In Question.

Compare the number of answers you're able to translate from memory across all your Live Check-In Questions to measure your progress.

MemAC Level 1: One answer at a time

When you beat Level 1, progress to Level 2.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice A.

Repeat the Translation of A from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice B.

Repeat the Translation of A and B from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice C.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice D.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice E.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D, E from memory.

MemAC Level 2: Two answers at a time

When you beat Level 2, progress to Level 3.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice A.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice B.

Repeat the Translation of A and B from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice C.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice D.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice E.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D, E from memory.

MemAC Level 3: Three answers at a time

When you beat Level 3, progress to Level 4.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice A.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice B.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice C.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice D.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice E.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D, E from memory.

MemAC Level 4: Four answers at a time

When you beat Level 4, progress to Level 5.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice A.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice B.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice C.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice D.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D from memory.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice E.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D, E from memory.

MemAC Level 5: Five answers at a time

When you beat Level 5, congratulations! You've beaten MemAC!

Read, translate, and quip answer choice A.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice B.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice C.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice D.

Read, translate, and quip answer choice E.

Repeat the Translation of A, B, C, D, E from memory.

SEE FULL WORKOUT DETAILS
